## Summary

Describe the public behavior changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate:release` passes
- [ ] Public API/type/documentation changes agree
- [ ] New provider requests are bounded and abortable
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or restricted live responses are included
- [ ] Data, dependency, license, and attribution implications are documented

## Compatibility

Describe any change to output schema, fingerprint behavior, provider contract, or supported runtime.
